items.label: Relay Therapeutics Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-16-2026)
items.signal_prefix: President of R&D Don Bergstrom said Relay 'were able to use our platform to discover a novel pocket in NRAS'

set.signal: President of R&D Don Bergstrom said Relay 'were able to use our platform to discover a novel pocket in NRAS' and exploit it to make an NRAS-selective inhibitor, RLY-8161, active as a single agent in preclinical melanoma, lung and colorectal models with almost no toxicity in non-clinical toxicology; it entered the clinic earlier this year. CEO Sanjiv Patel said the $911 million cash balance will fund mainly the three registrational trials (first-line, second-line and vascular anomalies), that the research footprint has been significantly reduced over the last few years and is a much smaller part of burn than in 2021-2022, and that in this cash window Relay can deliver top-line registrational data for the second-line and vascular anomalies trials and be significantly through the frontline trial.

items.reason: CEO said the research footprint was reduced 'over the last few years'; 2021-2022 is the comparison point for its share of burn, not the start of the reduction.
items.evidence: over the last few years, we have significantly reduced our research footprint, but it remains very productive, but it is obviously a much smaller part of our burn than it was back in 2021, 2022.
